correctness.rationale: The mathematical facet definition agrees exactly with an independently generated 32-triangle dual-graph perfect-matching census: 41 graph edges, 50 perfect matchings, 2,517,788 simplicial faces including the empty face. Two standalone verifiers independently replay the full nine-stage matching (pair counts 1011305,247522,30,26,3,3,1,1,1) and leave precisely one critical vertex and two critical four-simplices. The proof supplies and checks the nonstandard stagewise acyclicity argument, so the discrete Morse CW model is a point with two four-cells; the attaching maps are null. The known 2x2x2 and 2x2x1 controls are reproduced. Finite exhaustive computation proves this finite instance, not a family.

value.rationale: The 2022 honeycomb paper explicitly singles out wider two-dimensional cases as a remaining direction. The present 2x2x3 case is the smallest natural next-width increase after its 2x2x2 theorem, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact two-four-sphere homotopy type, established by a complete acyclic matching, gives structural information that the classical 50-tiling count or an Euler characteristic cannot provide. The result is finite but directly motivated and precise; no unfounded downstream general theorem is claimed.
